host.cpu: Intel Xeon Processor (Skylake, IBRS, no TSX), KVM, 4 vCPU

change: For 2- or 4-byte linear writes wholly inside one 4 KiB page, translate once before the first write and preserve ordered byte bus writes. Cross-page writes retain the prior all-byte translation preflight.

workload.name: stock xv6-public forktest, 4 MiB, Bochs BIOS
workload.command: XV6_LEAN=1 XV6_RAM_HASH=1 XV6_FIRMWARE=bochs XV6_STEPS=40000000 XV6_STOP_ON_EXPECT=1 XV6_COMMAND=$'forktest\r' XV6_EXPECT_SERIAL=$'fork test OK\n$ ' node scripts/probe-xv6-stock.mjs

guest.normalization: Replace only absolute ROM, xv6 image, and filesystem image paths with <rom> or <image>; retain every other JSON field in original order, including serial, interrupts, CPU, display and RAM hash. Hash SHA-256 of JSON.stringify of normalized parsed report.

profile.mode: Node --cpu-prof, full lean xv6 forktest before the change
profile.sampleType: V8 self samples; not exclusive CPU seconds

limits: This is a 4.2% workload-specific user-CPU throughput gain on a shared VPS, not calibrated 386DX real-time speed. Wall time varied substantially; the requested 10x overall gain remains open.
